environment.description: ECS task running in a public subnet with config-service.internal resolving via Route53 private hosted zone. The config service is exposed on a public ALB with no authentication. Any actor who can reach the ALB or perform DNS poisoning on the private zone can inject malicious routing_rules payloads. The CLI tool runs as root in the container with no seccomp profile.

config.network: Public subnet, IGW attached, no NACLs restricting egress
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, but VPC has DNS resolution from public resolvers enabled
config.service_exposure: Config service on public ALB, no auth, no WAF
config.container_runtime: ECS Fargate, task role has broad permissions, no seccomp
config.iam: Task execution role with ecs:* and ssm:GetParameter
